labels.claim_narrowing: Author narrows a claim or reduces overstatement.
labels.code_data_availability: Author provides code, data, weights, database, protocol, or availability details.
labels.figure_table_revision: Author revises figures, tables, captions, or visual presentation.
labels.future_work_commitment: Author defers the issue to future work.
labels.literature_repositioning: Author updates related work or contribution positioning.
labels.method_clarification: Author clarifies method, assumptions, or implementation.
labels.new_analysis: Author reports a new analysis, benchmark, robustness check, or comparison.
labels.new_baseline_or_comparison: Author adds or discusses additional baselines or comparative methods.
labels.new_experiment: Author reports a newly performed experiment or validation.
labels.no_new_evidence_explanation_only: Author explains existing evidence without new work.
labels.statistical_test_or_uncertainty: Author adds statistical testing, uncertainty estimates, sample-size discussion, or confidence intervals.
labels.supplementary_material_revision: Author moves or adds evidence to supplementary material.
